DIAGNOSIS READY: Acute Myeloid Leukemia

The CBC results showing a hemoglobin of 8.3 g/dL, a platelet count of 35,600/mm³, and a drastically elevated white blood cell count of 81,000/mm³, combined with normal iron/B12 levels, strongly indicate a bone marrow malignancy rather than simple anemia. Given your age and these specific pancytopenia findings, I suspect an acute leukemia. Do you have any history of bone pain, gum hypertrophy, or bruising?
